name: Violette
source:
A young girl who rules over Parterdeame and is the proxy, "Reine", of the sleeping goddess. She doesn't express many emotions and has a calm and wise personality. Due to being raised in such an isolated location she is unfamiliar with human nature.

Her house is a little distance away from the home of her instructor, Hubert. It is surrounded by plenty of nature and vivid blooming flowers. Her living room comes across as feminine and florid with its pink interior.

[from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/03/reines-des-fleurs-introduction/]otome-jikan[/url]]
